verdict.rationale: LangGraph's core model is explicitly graph-based (State, Nodes, Edges) with support for loops/cycles, branching, and parallelism via its Pregel/BSP execution model, confirmed both by docs and independent community technical commentary. missing for 10: no first-party hands-on benchmark of parallel-branch execution at scale, and community notes some friction with built-in parallelism complicating debugging.
